labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Rich already supports orange via named colors (orange1, dark_orange); this is a usage question.

body:
Rich already supports orange text through its named colors. For example, `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")` or the markup `[orange1]Hello[/]`. The full list of names is in the [colors appendix](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst).

If that does not do what you need, please describe the output you want in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions). The feature template in this issue was left unfilled, so it is not clear what else is needed.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
